purpose: Cause-based macro optical zoning for benchmark-visible park/street furniture. This supplements manufacture-scale microdetail without adding fake damage, wet sheen, baked illumination or placeholder geometry. Source compliance awards zero Visual Fidelity points until native 3840x2160 evidence is reviewed.

benchmarkClimate.lightingRule: all highlights remain generated by the coherent SummerSun, sky fill and reflection state; weathering may alter material response but never paint a highlight

forbidden: current wet sheen in the dry benchmark
rust on stainless slide running surface
weathering geometry shell or floating decal

assemblies.manufacture: painted steel access/deck/guard assembly with a separately fabricated SUS304 chute
assemblies.orientationExposure: horizontal tread/deck faces receive the strongest UV/rain dose; handrails receive repeated skin contact; stainless chute receives travel-direction abrasion but no coating chalk

zones.source: solar UV plus direct rain wash
zones.transport_or_contact: direct exposure on upward access plates
zones.retention_or_exposure: deck and ten access tread components remain continuously exposed
zones.material_response: same dielectric paint microtextures and metallic class as the base coating, with restrained smoothness reduction and no added geometry

zones.retention_or_exposure: contact follows the rail components rather than unrelated frame members
zones.material_response: same dielectric paint maps with a small smoothness increase; no albedo highlight is painted
delegated to PBR_SlideStainless directional microdetail; the authoritative chute material must not be replaced by this zoning pass

assemblies.manufacture: five exterior timber slats over a steel bearer and precast supports
assemblies.orientationExposure: seat slats are upward-facing and receive direct midsummer UV/rain; the support feet already carry a separate causal grade-contact concrete state

zones.source: solar UV and repeated drying cycles
zones.transport_or_contact: direct exposure on the seat slat assembly
zones.retention_or_exposure: all high-detail slats and the LOD2/3 seat proxy represent the same exposed seat surface
zones.material_response: base timber albedo/normal/roughness textures are preserved while tint/smoothness are shifted only slightly toward a dry UV-aged state

zones.source: splash and capillary moisture at grade
zones.transport_or_contact: ground splash and concrete pore transport
zones.retention_or_exposure: lowest visible 120 mm contact components only
zones.material_response: delegated to PBR_ParkContactConcrete; this pass must not extend the band upward

assemblies.manufacture: painted steel weatherproof display case with top runoff hood, clear acrylic cover, EPDM seal and sheltered paper/backing
assemblies.orientationExposure: top frame and runoff hood receive the largest UV/rain dose; backing and paper remain sheltered behind the cover

zones.transport_or_contact: direct top-surface exposure followed by runoff
zones.material_response: same painted-steel PBR maps and dielectric class with restrained smoothness reduction; no runoff highlight or fake opaque stain is added

zones.transport_or_contact: none under normal dry benchmark conditions
zones.material_response: left unchanged by this pass so sheltered surfaces do not receive exterior-weathering noise

assemblies.manufacture: continuous tapered concrete pole with retained globe head and weather-sealed service cover
assemblies.orientationExposure: full exterior exposure with a localized grade-contact moisture zone

zones.source: UV, rain, wiping and ground splash
zones.transport_or_contact: as encoded by the park-lamp installation and microdetail contracts
zones.retention_or_exposure: flush lower-pole submesh plus aged diffuser/paint microdetail
zones.material_response: this pass intentionally does not alter HD_Lamp, avoiding duplicate weathering systems

materialVariants.uvAging: mild chalking/oxidation response on directly exposed painted components
materialVariants.angularResponse: dielectric Fresnel from scene light/probes; no baked specular
slightly tighter real reflection response only; no albedo highlight

materialVariants.uvAging: dry surface oxidation/bleaching tendency represented conservatively without inventing cracks
materialVariants.angularResponse: rough dielectric timber response driven by real light/probes

geometryVsMaterialDetail.geometry: no new weathering geometry is allowed; assembly thickness, joins, seals, supports, chute solid, notice-case depth and lamp moisture submesh remain owned by their construction contracts
geometryVsMaterialDetail.material: component-scale exposure/contact zoning may change only color multiplier and smoothness scaling while retaining the authoritative base textures, normal scale and metallic class

lodPolicy.rule: the same causal class must persist across LOD0/1/2/3; component name substitutions such as HandrailTop versus AccessPlatformTransitionTop and SeatSlat versus SeatProxy are explicit so weathering cannot pop by content class

failureInjection: replace one slide tread with base paint so its exposure class disappears
replace an access handrail with UV-exposed instead of contact-polished paint
replace PhysicalChute material with a weathering variant
drop source normal or metallic-smoothness map identity
change texture scale or offset on a weathering variant
enable emission on a weathering variant
apply exterior weathering to sheltered notice paper/backing
remove LOD3 exposure substitution so the weathering class pops

requiredEvidence: 100% crops of slide access paint, bench seat timber and notice-board top frame/hood
temporal oblique/grazing sequence for LOD/material-class stability
